R2_projection_assumptions.beta_electron: existing electron_fast count carrier; no energy distribution or thermal deposition assigned
R2_projection_assumptions.charge: all material nuclei bare; chosen number projection, not image ionic placement
R2_projection_assumptions.inclusive_primary_states: primary ground-plus-excited channels remain inclusive; no branch fractions or ground-only source binding
R2_projection_assumptions.material_pools: number projection only; instant thermalization is the historical conditional model assumption
R2_projection_assumptions.normalization: compiler reference-nucleus/proper-second event operator; no native coefficient normalization binding
R2_projection_assumptions.nuclear_state: R1 ground nuclear labels reused as declared coordinates; source isomer/state not thereby qualified

source_limits.aggregation: unresolved aggregate and resolved states must not be evolved together without a partition map
source_limits.anions: One source H- candidate; no molecular or other anion catalogue completeness claim.
source_limits.electron_UMIST: Source pool unresolved; electron_thermal coordinate is not a new thermalization admission.
source_limits.isomers: Electronic excited states are not nuclear isomers; no non-ground nuclear isomer is active among the 92.
source_limits.molecules: 17 identities include H2, ortho/para H2, H2+, H3+, HeH+, HD J0..8 and Li6H1/Li7H1; unresolved electronic/vibrational/isotope qualifications remain.
source_limits.neutral_H_He_source: Additional two-ground-state NIST field transcription; WU bare mass records remain unchanged.
source_limits.scalar_sources: Thermal rates, total cross sections, A-values, branch/yield and beam-averaged records do not supply full joint differential collision laws.

thermodynamic_contract.binding_internal_energy: Explicit excitation, ionization, molecular and nuclear energy coordinates each have one owner.
thermodynamic_contract.bulk_energy: Bulk momentum work and thermal heating are separate projections of the same event exchange.
thermodynamic_contract.heat_capacity: Cv is a partial derivative of thermal internal energy at fixed independent population coordinates.
thermodynamic_contract.molecular_heat_capacity: Resolved internal populations and unresolved partition contributions require a non-overlapping convention.
thermodynamic_contract.nonthermal_energy: Fast pools are not thermal energy until a qualified deposition event transfers energy.
thermodynamic_contract.particle_count: Thermal particle count and its source term remain separate from Cv.
thermodynamic_contract.source_ownership: A provider candidate or rate table is not a second energy ledger owner.
